utility.notes: DTE Energy is Ann Arbor's well-established dominant electric utility.

value.name: DTE Energy
value.notes: No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Ann Arbor's residential solar customers this session; DTE Energy is recorded as both the distribution and default generation utility.

permit_authority.notes: Michigan's Residential Code (currently the 2015 edition — a 2021 IRC update was filed in 2025 but delayed by a court order, per state guidance referenced this session) sets the statewide baseline, but enforcement is delegated to whichever local jurisdiction (city, township, or county) has assumed local-enforcing-agency status; where none has, Michigan's state Bureau of Construction Codes enforces directly. Ann Arbor's own city government administers its expedited residential solar permitting process directly.

interconnection_url.notes: DTE Energy's traditional Net Metering program closed to new applications on 2019-05-09. Current interconnection runs through the 'Rider 18 Distributed Generation Program' (approved by the Michigan Public Service Commission), which most residential systems (Category 1, up to 20kW) enter via a $50 interconnection application fee with a typical 5-6 week timeline to Permission to Operate. Applications are submitted through DTE's PowerClerk-based portal (dteinterconnect.powerclerk.com); customers must obtain a signed Parallel Operating Agreement before DTE's site visit and install an externally located, taggable disconnect switch within 5 feet of the meter. The system must stay off until DTE completes inspection and testing. Existing Rider 16 (legacy net metering) customers convert to Rider 18 upon their 10-year net-metering anniversary.

battery_programs.notes: The City's own page notes that residential rooftop solar installations WITH battery storage are excluded from the expedited permitting program and follow a different (unspecified, not detailed on the page fetched this session) procedure — this describes a permitting-track distinction, not a financial battery incentive program, which was not independently confirmed this session.
